## Products

### NoteTaker AI
- Category: AI Call Recorder for iPhone
- Platforms: iOS 26+, watchOS 26+
- Price: Free
- Key feature: First local AI call recorder for iPhone
- Technology: Apple Intelligence (on-device)
- Privacy: 100% on-device processing, zero data collected, no cloud, no analytics
- Features: Smart recording, automatic transcription, AI summarization, AI chat, Apple Watch support, Dynamic Island integration, Face ID lock
- Languages: French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese, and more
- App Store privacy label: "No Data Collected"
- Page: https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/notetaker-ai.html

### Better Dictate
- Category: Offline Voice-to-Text for Mac
- Platforms: macOS 13.0+ (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 required)
- Price: Free
- Key feature: Best offline voice-to-text app for Mac powered by Whisper AI
- Technology: Whisper AI (open source, runs locally), Metal GPU acceleration
- Privacy: 100% offline, voice processed in memory and immediately discarded, zero data stored or transmitted
- Features: Push-to-Talk, Dictate to Clipboard, Live Translation, custom dictionary, assistive technology, choice of 4 Whisper models (Tiny 75MB, Small 500MB, Medium 1.5GB, Large 3GB)
- Languages: 90+ languages including French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Arabic, Auto-detect
- Page: https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/better-dictate.html
